given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser is logged in and views the Product Catalog
given_when_then.when: The Merchandiser submits a new product entry with all required fields filled
given_when_then.then: The system creates the new entry, assigns it as the current version, and displays a success message

given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser attempts to update a product entry that is in an archived state
given_when_then.when: The Merchandiser submits the update request
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the request and displays an error message indicating the entry is archived

given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser attempts to create a new product entry with a missing required field
given_when_then.when: The Merchandiser submits the new entry request
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the request and displays an error message indicating the missing field

success_criteria: The system must allow the Merchandiser to add new items to the Product Catalog.
The system must require the product name field to be populated before a new entry is created.
The system must require the price field to be populated before a new entry is created.
The system must retain previous versions of a product and mark them as archived when a new version is published.
The system must not allow updating a product entry if it is in an archived state.
The system must include a timestamp and the identifier of the user making a change to any product update.
